name: Light Inspection
hint: Observe the inspection light from behind solid cover. It cannot harm you.

decor.title: Inspection protocol
decor.text:
Inspection lamp: no fixing agent. Harmless.
Solid objects stop light. Glass does not.
Record one sheltered exposure to release the shutter.

start: This is only an inspection lamp. There is no fixing agent. You cannot be hurt here.
Wren had me add the shelter interlock. She wanted the technicians to be able to step away.
inspection:exposed: That is an exposure. Harmless here. In the enlarging room, I use a stronger lamp.
inspection:sheltered: The pillar stopped the light. Glass would not have. The interlock has released the shutter.
nudge: Stand in the shadow cast by the solid pillar and wait for the lamp to finish charging.
nudge2: Move behind the central pillar, near the entrance, and wait for one exposure. Then go through the open shutter.

mustFail.why: walk out before observing a sheltered exposure
